**Cause:** `UserService.GetUserByID` in `internal/service/user.go` caught the "user not found" error and returned `(nil, nil)`. `GetCurrentUser` only checks `err`, so it carried on with a nil user and dereferenced it. That is what happens when a valid token belongs to a user who has been deleted.

**Fix:** `GetUserByID` now returns any repository error, including "user not found". The handler already turns an error into a 404 response. This was the only caller of `GetUserByID`, so nothing else depended on the old behaviour.
